nodes.name: bistro chair
nodes.caption: A classic bistro-style chair with a curved backrest and seat woven from light-brown rattan or wicker, supported by four slender, dark-painted metal legs that splay outward slightly; the chair is upright and positioned around a small round table on a sidewalk.

nodes.name: bistro chair
nodes.caption: Another identical bistro chair with a woven rattan back and seat, dark metal frame, and splayed legs; it sits adjacent to the first chair, angled slightly toward the table, casting a sharp shadow in the late afternoon sun.

nodes.name: cafe table
nodes.caption: A small round outdoor café table with a smooth, light-colored (likely laminate or painted wood) top and a black cast-iron pedestal base with three ornate, curved legs ending in flat feet; it stands centrally among the chairs on the sidewalk.

nodes.name: patio umbrella
nodes.caption: A large market-style patio umbrella with a beige fabric canopy segmented into eight panels, supported by a central wooden or metal pole that extends down to a heavy, circular, dual-disk metal base resting on the pavement; the pole has a crank mechanism and tilt joint visible near the canopy.

nodes.name: city bicycle
nodes.caption: A vintage-style city bicycle with a silver or light-gray metallic frame, upright handlebars, a front wire basket containing greenery, a rear rack, fenders over both wheels, and black tires; it is parked leaning against a planter box on the sidewalk, with its kickstand deployed.

nodes.name: bistro chair
nodes.caption: A third matching bistro chair with woven rattan back and seat, dark metal frame, and splayed legs; it is positioned opposite the table, partially under the umbrella’s shadow, and appears slightly more angled than the others.

nodes.name: bistro chair
nodes.caption: A fourth identical bistro chair, same woven rattan construction and dark metal frame, placed on the far side of the table; its orientation suggests it faces the street, and it casts a distinct elongated shadow due to low-angle sunlight.
